take.title_zh: 模型軍備賽持續，設計工具押注「畫布即產品」
take.title_en: Model Race Rolls On, Design Tools Bet on the Canvas-as-Product
take.body_zh:
本週 AI 陣營持續放量：Anthropic 把 Sonnet 4.6 設為 Claude 與 Cowork 的預設模型並加入 1M token 上下文，Alibaba 的 Qwen3.8 Max 也在本週上線，加上 xAI Grok 4、Google DeepMind Genie 3.0 世界模型陸續刷新討論度，模型層的競爭已從單純參數規模轉向情境長度與多模態世界模擬。

另一條線是 Figma：Config 2026 後系列文章顯示畫布正在吸收動畫時間軸、3D、生成式外掛與程式碼輸出，AI 已能直接寫文案、拼 UI、出代碼。對設計師而言，工具邊界模糊化意味著早期就要與 PM、工程師共用同一張畫布，策略性思考的比重會持續上升。
take.body_en:
AI vendors kept shipping this week: Anthropic made Sonnet 4.6 the default model across Claude and Cowork with a 1M-token context window in beta, Alibaba shipped Qwen3.8 Max, and xAI's Grok 4 plus Google DeepMind's Genie 3.0 world model kept the benchmark conversation going. The competition is shifting from raw parameter count toward context length and multimodal world simulation.

On the tools side, the post-Config 2026 wave of Figma coverage shows the canvas absorbing motion timelines, 3D, generative plugins, and code export, with AI now drafting copy, UI, and code directly. For designers, blurring tool boundaries means sharing one canvas with PMs and engineers earlier, pushing the job further toward strategic thinking.

articles.title_zh: Anthropic 發布 Claude Opus 4.6、Sonnet 4.6，1M token 上下文進 Beta
articles.title_en: Anthropic Ships Claude Opus 4.6 and Sonnet 4.6 With 1M-Token Context in Beta
articles.summary_zh: Anthropic 推出 Claude Opus 4.6 與 Sonnet 4.6，後者新增 1M token 上下文視窗（Beta），並成為 Claude 與 Cowork 中的預設模型。此舉代表 Anthropic 把長上下文能力下放到主力模型，方便處理大型程式庫、長文件與多輪代理任務，也讓 Cowork 這類自動化工作流可以一次帶入更多背景資料。
articles.summary_en: Anthropic released Claude Opus 4.6 and Sonnet 4.6, with Sonnet 4.6 gaining a 1M-token context window in beta and becoming the default model across Claude and Cowork. The move pushes long-context capability into Anthropic's mainline model, making it easier to handle large codebases, long documents, and multi-turn agent tasks with more background loaded at once.
articles.take_zh: 把長上下文設為預設值，等於把「一次塞更多資料」變成常態工作方式，對做研究彙整、跨檔案編輯的工作流是直接利好。
articles.take_en: Making long context the default turns "load more at once" into the standard workflow — a direct win for research synthesis and cross-file editing tasks.

articles.title_zh: Qwen3.8 Max 上線，加上 Grok 4、Genie 3.0 世界模型持續刷榜
articles.title_en: Qwen3.8 Max Lands as Grok 4 and Genie 3.0 Keep Pushing Benchmarks
articles.summary_zh: Alibaba 於本月初推出 Qwen3.8 Max，是近期最新上線的旗艙模型；同期 xAI 的 Grok 4 在 ARC-AGI v2、Humanity's Last Exam 等測驗刷新分數，Google DeepMind 的 Genie 3.0「世界模型」則能從文字生成可維持數分鐘一致性的互動 3D 環境。三者合觀,顯示競爭同時在推理分數與生成式世界模擬兩個維度展開。
articles.summary_en: Alibaba released Qwen3.8 Max in early August, its latest flagship model, while xAI's Grok 4 posted new highs on ARC-AGI v2 and Humanity's Last Exam, and Google DeepMind's Genie 3.0 world model can now generate interactive 3D environments from text that stay consistent for several minutes. Together they show competition running on both reasoning benchmarks and generative world simulation.
articles.take_zh: 世界模型與推理分數同時推進,意味未來的模型評測不會只看單一榜單,設計師若做互動原型,值得關注生成式環境這條支線。
articles.take_en: With world models and reasoning scores advancing in parallel, model evaluation is no longer single-leaderboard — designers building interactive prototypes should watch the generative-environment track closely.

articles.title_zh: Figma Config 2026 回顧：動畫時間軸、3D、Shader 全部搬進畫布
articles.title_en: Figma Config 2026 Recap: Motion, 3D, and Shaders All Move Onto the Canvas
articles.summary_zh: Figma 官方發文回顧 Config 2026 發布的新材質與工具，包含內建動畫時間軸（含關鍵幀、緩動曲線、彈簧動畫）、3D 變形效果、Shader、生成式外掛與 Weave 工具，全部不需離開畫布即可完成。Figma Agent 還能依文字提示生成第一版動畫，設計師再手動微調並匯出可用程式碼。
articles.summary_en: Figma's own recap of Config 2026 covers new canvas materials and tools: a built-in animation timeline with keyframes, easing, and spring animation; 3D transforms; shaders; generative plugins; and new Weave tools — all without leaving the canvas. The Figma Agent can draft a first-pass animation from a text prompt for designers to refine and export as code.
articles.take_zh: 動畫、3D、程式碼輸出全部收進同一張畫布，代表設計交付的最後一哩路正在被工具直接吃掉，值得重新盤點團隊的交接流程。
articles.take_en: Folding animation, 3D, and code export into one canvas means the last mile of design handoff is being absorbed by the tool itself — worth revisiting how your team hands off work.

articles.title_zh: LogRocket 盤點 2026 年的 Figma AI：能做什麼、還做不到什麼
articles.title_en: LogRocket Maps Figma AI in 2026: What It Can Do — and What It Still Can't
articles.summary_zh: LogRocket 整理 2026 年 Figma AI 的完整能力清單：寫文案、拼裝 UI 元件、產生程式碼、直接建站等，同時指出目前仍有的限制，例如複雜互動邏輯與跨系統一致性仍需人工把關。文章適合作為團隊評估要把哪些流程交給 AI、哪些仍須保留人工審核的參考清單。
articles.summary_en: LogRocket rounds up what Figma AI can do as of 2026 — writing copy, assembling UI components, generating code, even building sites directly — while flagging current limits around complex interaction logic and cross-system consistency, which still need human review. It works well as a checklist for deciding which steps to hand to AI versus keep manual.
articles.take_zh: 把「能做」與「還不能做」並列，比單純吹捧新功能更實用，團隊導入 AI 工具時可以直接拿來做風險清單。
articles.take_en: Listing capabilities alongside limits is more useful than feature hype alone — teams can lift this directly as a risk checklist when rolling out AI tools.

articles.title_zh: Figma 公布 4 種用 AI 工具「從點子到產品」的新做法
articles.title_en: Figma Shares 4 New Ways to Go From Idea to Product With AI Tools
articles.summary_zh: Figma 官方發文介紹四種新的 AI 輔助工作流,讓構想能更快落地成可用產品,涵蓋從發散構思、快速拼版到產出可交付素材的路徑。內容強調 AI 是加速器而非取代者,設計師仍需在每個步驟做判斷與篩選,而非全自動放行。
articles.summary_en: Figma's blog walks through four new AI-assisted workflows for turning ideas into shippable product faster, covering ideation, rapid layout, and producing deliverable-ready assets. The framing stays consistent: AI accelerates the path, but designers still make the calls at each step rather than letting it run fully automated.
articles.take_zh: 四種做法都圍繞「加速但不取代判斷」,對想導入 AI 工作流卻擔心失去把關權的團隊,是相對溫和的切入點。
articles.take_en: All four workflows center on accelerating rather than replacing judgment — a gentler entry point for teams wary of losing control when adopting AI workflows.

articles.title_zh: Qubika 解讀 Figma Config 2026：對設計師實際意味著什麼
articles.title_en: Qubika Breaks Down Figma Config 2026: What It Actually Means for Designers
articles.summary_zh: 第三方觀察媒體 Qubika 逐項整理 Figma Config 2026 的公告,並從設計師實際工作角度解讀影響,例如動畫與 3D 工具下放後,團隊分工可能從「設計師畫、工程師實作」轉為「設計師直接輸出可用素材」。文章補足官方公告較少談的組織與流程層面衝擊。
articles.summary_en: Third-party outlet Qubika breaks down each Figma Config 2026 announcement and interprets the practical impact on designers' day-to-day work — for instance, as motion and 3D tools move into designer hands, team division of labor may shift from "designer sketches, engineer builds" toward designers shipping usable assets directly. It fills in the organizational and workflow angle official posts tend to skip.
articles.take_zh: 官方公告談功能,第三方分析談組織衝擊,兩者對照看比較能判斷這波更新是否值得團隊立刻調整分工。
articles.take_en: Official posts cover features; third-party analysis covers organizational impact — reading both together makes it easier to judge whether this update warrants an immediate change in team workflow.
